answer: The opal schedule is applied in nebula and beacon shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 32% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2855 identities would post 1531 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
